reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Mississippi
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for violating statutory tenant obligations?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic scenario metadata
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

state(mississippi).
focus_year(2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Parties, premises, and agreement (scenario facts)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

landlord(l1).
tenant(t1).
premises(p1).

tenancy(t1, l1, p1).
written_rental_agreement(t1, l1, p1).

/* Scenario timeline (simple day-count model).
   We treat "receipt" of notice as day 0, and "today" as day 20. */
current_day(20).

/* Tenant is still in possession and does not have permission after termination. */
tenant_in_possession(t1, p1).
landlord_permission_to_possess(l1, t1, p1, no).
tenant_surrendered_possession(t1, p1, no).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% MS Code  89-8-25 (2020) - Statutory tenant obligations (encoded)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% statute_ms_89_8_25_obligation/1 enumerates the statutory tenant duties.
statute_ms_89_8_25_obligation(keep_premises_clean_and_safe).                          % 89-8-25
statute_ms_89_8_25_obligation(dispose_waste_cleanly_and_safely).                      % 89-8-25
statute_ms_89_8_25_obligation(keep_plumbing_fixtures_clean).                          % 89-8-25
statute_ms_89_8_25_obligation(use_facilities_reasonably).                             % 89-8-25
statute_ms_89_8_25_obligation(not_damage_premises).                                   % 89-8-25
statute_ms_89_8_25_obligation(not_disturb_neighbors_peaceful_enjoyment).              % 89-8-25
statute_ms_89_8_25_obligation(inform_landlord_of_known_damaging_condition).           % 89-8-25
statute_ms_89_8_25_obligation(maintain_unit_subject_to_wear_tear_and_codes).          % 89-8-25
statute_ms_89_8_25_obligation(no_illegal_activity_documented_by_law_enforcement).     % 89-8-25

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% MS Code  89-8-13 (2020) - Termination for material noncompliance (encoded)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* material_obligation/1 is a policy choice for this logic model.
   The statute requires "material noncompliance"; we mark certain obligations as
   material when violated. */
material_obligation(not_disturb_neighbors_peaceful_enjoyment).

/* Scenario: tenant violates a statutory tenant obligation (89-8-25). */
tenant_violated_statutory_obligation(t1, not_disturb_neighbors_peaceful_enjoyment).

/* Scenario: breach is caused by the tenant (so the "neither party may terminate for
   a condition caused by his own deliberate or negligent act" does not bar landlord). */
condition_caused_by_party(t1, t1, yes).  % condition_caused_by_party(ConditionActor, PartyTerminatingAgainst, yes)

/* Scenario: landlord served a written notice that:
   - specifies the breach,
   - states the rental agreement will terminate on a date >= 14 days after receipt,
   - allows remediation within a reasonable time <= 14 days.
   We model this as days-after-receipt integers. */
notice_of_breach(
    l1, t1,
    method_written,                          % written notice
    specifies_acts_and_omissions_yes,         % specifies breach
    termination_day_after_receipt(14),        % termination date (>=14)
    remedy_deadline_day_after_receipt(14)     % remedy period (<=14)
).

/* Scenario: tenant did not adequately remedy the breach before termination. */
breach_adequately_remedied_before_termination(t1, no).

/* Helper: numeric comparison predicates (deterministic). */
at_least_14_days(Days) :-
    integer(Days),
    Days >= 14.

not_more_than_14_days(Days) :-
    integer(Days),
    Days =< 14.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% MS Code  89-7-27 (2020) - Removal / eviction cases (encoded)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* 89-7-27 First: holdover after expiration of term without permission.
   We treat a properly terminated rental agreement as expiration of the tenant's term. */

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Derived legal conclusions
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* material_noncompliance_by_tenant/2
   Encodes: "material noncompliance by tenant with ... obligations imposed by 89-8-25"
   (MS Code 89-8-13 (2020)). */
material_noncompliance_by_tenant(Tenant, Obligation) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    statute_ms_89_8_25_obligation(Obligation),
    tenant_violated_statutory_obligation(Tenant, Obligation),
    material_obligation(Obligation).

/* landlord_may_terminate_for_material_noncompliance/3
   Encodes the main termination pathway in 89-8-13(2020), including:
   - material noncompliance,
   - proper notice with >=14 days termination date,
   - remediable breach not remedied by deadline,
   - termination not based on condition caused by terminating party's own act. */
landlord_may_terminate_for_material_noncompliance(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    premises(Premises),
    tenancy(Tenant, Landlord, Premises),
    material_noncompliance_by_tenant(Tenant, _Obligation),
    notice_of_breach(
        Landlord, Tenant,
        method_written,
        specifies_acts_and_omissions_yes,
        termination_day_after_receipt(TermDays),
        remedy_deadline_day_after_receipt(RemedyDays)
    ),
    at_least_14_days(TermDays),
    not_more_than_14_days(RemedyDays),
    breach_adequately_remedied_before_termination(Tenant, no),
    % "Neither party may terminate for a condition caused by his own deliberate or negligent act"
    % Here the condition is caused by the tenant, not by the landlord.
    condition_caused_by_party(Tenant, Tenant, yes).

/* tenancy_terminated/3
   If landlord may terminate under 89-8-13 and the termination date has passed. */
tenancy_terminated(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    landlord_may_terminate_for_material_noncompliance(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    notice_of_breach(Landlord, Tenant, method_written, specifies_acts_and_omissions_yes,
                     termination_day_after_receipt(TermDays),
                     remedy_deadline_day_after_receipt(_RemedyDays)),
    current_day(Today),
    integer(Today),
    Today > TermDays.

term_expired(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    tenancy_terminated(Landlord, Tenant, Premises).

/* eviction_ground_holdover/3
   89-7-27 First. */
eviction_ground_holdover(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    tenancy(Tenant, Landlord, Premises),
    term_expired(Landlord, Tenant, Premises),
    tenant_in_possession(Tenant, Premises),
    landlord_permission_to_possess(Landlord, Tenant, Premises, no),
    tenant_surrendered_possession(Tenant, Premises, no).

/* legal_can_evict/3
   For this question, we treat "evict" as "landlord has a statutory ground to remove tenant".
   Here, holdover after termination satisfies 89-7-27 First. */
legal_can_evict(Landlord, Tenant, Premises) :-
    eviction_ground_holdover(Landlord, Tenant, Premises).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario statement (must fully reflect the encoded question scenario)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the scenario facts match the posed question:
   - Tenant violates a statutory tenant obligation (89-8-25),
   - Violation is material and not cured after proper 89-8-13 notice,
   - Tenancy is terminated and tenant remains in possession without permission,
   - Therefore landlord has eviction/removal ground (89-7-27). */
scenario_statement :-
    state(mississippi),
    focus_year(2021),
    landlord(l1),
    tenant(t1),
    premises(p1),
    tenancy(t1, l1, p1),
    written_rental_agreement(t1, l1, p1),
    tenant_violated_statutory_obligation(t1, not_disturb_neighbors_peaceful_enjoyment),
    landlord_may_terminate_for_material_noncompliance(l1, t1, p1),
    tenancy_terminated(l1, t1, p1),
    tenant_in_possession(t1, p1),
    landlord_permission_to_possess(l1, t1, p1, no).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    legal_can_evict(l1, t1, p1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for violating statutory tenant obligations?
